title: SLB OneSubsea Awarded Contract for Lyra Field Development Offshore Norway
summary: Close collaboration and standardized subsea technology accelerate path to first production
body_markdown:
## Close collaboration and standardized subsea technology accelerate path to first production


**HOUSTON, November 5, 2026 —** Global energy technology company SLB (NYSE: SLB) today announced that its OneSubsea™ joint venture has been awarded a contract by Aker BP to deliver subsea production systems, umbilicals and associated services for the Lyra field development, formerly known as Kjøttkake, on the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS).


Building on nearly a decade of collaboration through Aker BP’s alliance model, Aker BP and SLB OneSubsea worked together from the early stages of the project to shape the development strategy for Lyra. The field will be developed as a subsea tieback to existing infrastructure using proven, standardized subsea technology to reduce development complexity, improve execution efficiency and accelerate the path to first production.


“Lyra shows what is possible with fast-track field development,” said Mads Hjelmeland, chief executive officer, SLB OneSubsea. “Working together from the earliest stages allows us to shape development strategies around our customers’ priorities and create new opportunities for offshore resources.”


“Our alliance with SLB OneSubsea, combined with standardized subsea technology, has been central to how we are developing Lyra,” said Marte Mogstad, senior vice president, Aker BP. “The project demonstrates how we together can make marginal resources economically viable through fast track execution, with three years from discovery to first oil.”


### Key Points:


- SLB OneSubsea has been awarded a contract by Aker BP to deliver subsea production systems, umbilicals and associated services for the Lyra field development on the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS).
- Lyra will be developed as a subsea tieback to existing infrastructure, using standardized technology to reduce complexity and accelerate the path to first production.
- The project provides a model for fast-track field development and a blueprint for future developments on the NCS.

### About SLB OneSubsea


SLB OneSubsea is driving a new subsea era leveraging digital and technology innovation to optimize our customers’ oil and gas production, reduce emissions in subsea operations, and unlock the large potential of subsea solutions to shape a sustainable energy future. SLB OneSubsea is a joint venture backed by SLB, Aker Solutions, and Subsea7 headquartered in Oslo and Houston, with 10,000 employees across the world.
